name: rosetta-divide-a-rectangle-into-a-number-of-unequal-triangles
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES
use System.Math

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    +(o: P) -> P => P(x + o.x, y + o.y)
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    *(k: double) -> P => P(x * k, y * k)
    ×(o: P) -> double => x * o.y - y * o.x
    length: double => Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
    show: string => "({x:F2}, {y:F2})"
si

use Triangle = (a: P, b: P, c: P)

sides(t: Triangle) -> List[double] =>
    [(t.b - t.a).length, (t.c - t.b).length, (t.a - t.c).length]
        |> sort((p, q) => p <> q)
        |> collect_list()

similar(s: Triangle, t: Triangle) -> bool =>
    let x = sides(s), y = sides(t) in
    (0..3) |> all(i => Math.abs(x[i] / x[2] - y[i] / y[2]) < 1.0e-6)

area(t: Triangle) -> double =>
    Math.abs((t.b - t.a) × (t.c - t.a)) / 2.0D

all_different(ts: List[Triangle]) -> bool =>
    (0..ts.count) |> all(i =>
        (i + 1..ts.count) |> all(j => !similar(ts[i], ts[j])))

length(e: (P, P, P)) -> double => (e.`1 - e.`0).length

split(t: Triangle, at: double) -> (Triangle, Triangle) is
    let edges = [(t.a, t.b, t.c), (t.b, t.c, t.a), (t.c, t.a, t.b)]
    let (p, q, opposite) =
        edges |> reduce(edges[0], (best, e) =>
            if length(e) > length(best) then e else best fi)

    let point = p + (q - p) * at

    ((p, point, opposite), (point, q, opposite))
si

let random = System.Random(5)

divide(width: double, height: double, count: int) -> List[Triangle] is
    assert count >= 3 else "at least three triangles are needed"

    do
        let top = P(width * (0.2D + 0.6D * random.next_double()), height)
        let triangles = LIST[Triangle]([
            (P(0.0D, 0.0D), P(0.0D, height), top),
            (P(0.0D, 0.0D), top, P(width, 0.0D)),
            (P(width, 0.0D), top, P(width, height))
        ])

        let tries mut = 0

        while triangles.count < count /\ tries < 1000 do
            let largest =
                (0..triangles.count) |> reduce(0, (best, i) =>
                    if area(triangles[i]) > area(triangles[best]) then i
                    else best fi)

            let at = 0.25D + random.next_double() / 2.0D
            let (first, second) = split(triangles[largest], at)

            let candidate =
                triangles |> index() |> filter(e => e.index != largest)
                    |> map(e => e.value) |> collect_list()

            candidate.add(first)
            candidate.add(second)

            if all_different(candidate) then
                triangles.clear()
                triangles.add_range(candidate)
            fi

            tries = tries + 1
        od

        if triangles.count == count /\ all_different(triangles) then
            return triangles
        fi
    od
si

write_line("A random point on the top edge, joined to both bottom corners,")
write_line("cuts the rectangle into three triangles. Then, until there are")
write_line("enough, the largest triangle is cut from a random point on")
write_line("its longest side to the opposite corner, and a cut that would")
write_line("leave two similar triangles is tried again somewhere else.")
write_line("")

for count in [3, 5, 8] do
    let triangles = divide(8.0D, 5.0D, count)
    let total = triangles |> map(area) |> reduce(0.0D, (a, b) => a + b)

    write_line("{count} triangles covering an area of {total:F2}:")

    for t in triangles do
        write_line("  {t.a.show} {t.b.show} {t.c.show}")
    od

    write_line("")
od

let many = divide(8.0D, 5.0D, 30)

write_line("30 triangles, drawn below")
write_line("no two similar: {all_different(many)}")

let image = IMAGE(480, 300)
let tiles = SHAPES()

image.view(-0.1D, -0.1D, 8.1D, 5.1D)
image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 245ub)

for (i, t) in many |> index() do
    let shade = cast ubyte(120 + (i * 37) % 120)

    tiles.add(
        [t.a, t.b, t.c] |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y)) |> collect_list(),
        (shade - 80ub, shade - 30ub, 255ub - shade / 3ub))
od

image.fill(tiles)
image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 50ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)

for t in many do
    let corners = [t.a, t.b, t.c, t.a] |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y))

    image.line(corners |> collect_list())
od

image.write("triangles.png")

image.show("triangles.png")
